sentences.text: ORAL JUDGMENT Heard learned advocate Mr.K.T.Dave for the petitioner, learned Assistant Government NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/15618/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/04/2023 undefined Pleader Ms.Hetal Patel for the respondent Nos.1 to 3 and learned advocate Mr.Bhadrish S. Raju for the respondent No.4-Airport Authority of India.
1. Rule, returnable forthwith.
Learned Assistant Government Pleader Ms.Hetal Patel and learned advocate Mr.Bhadrish Raju waive service of notice of rule on behalf of the respective respondents.
2. Having regard to the controversy arising in this petition in narrow compass, the same is taken for hearing with the consent of the learned advocates of the respective parties.
3.1. The brief facts of the case are that the petitioner is a retired Lieutenant Colonel and has served in the Indian Army.
NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/15618/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/04/2023 undefined 3.2.
It is the case of the petitioner that when he was serving as a Captain in the Indian Army in the year 1970 and after receiving various promotions he retired as a Lieutenant Colonel.

The petitioner made an application on 01.05.1969 for allotment of 16 Acre of land of Survey No.230 of Village:Gaviyar,
Taluka:
Choriyasi, District:Surat. 3.3.

By order dated 23.12.1970, the Collector, Surat allotted 16 Acres i.e. 64750 Sq.Mtrs of land out of Suvey No.230 of Village:Gaviyar, District:
Surat.
3.4. Pursuant to the allotment of the land, Revenue Entry No.700 was mutated in the Revenue Record reflecting the allottment of the land in name of the petitioner.

In the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/15618/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/04/2023 undefined Village Form No.7/12 extract also the name of the petitioner is reflected showing the petitioner in possession of the land in question.

3.5. It is also the case of the petitioner that he has paid land revenue for the aforesaid land in question from the date of allotment till the year 2016-17 and he was cultivating the land and has developed the land till the same was encroached upon illegally by the respondent NO.4. 3.6.

It appears that for the purpose of building Runway of the Airport, huge parcel of the land was acquired from different survey numbers from six different villages for Surat Airport and the same was acquired in three phases.

It appears that the land of the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/15618/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/04/2023 undefined petitioner is also considered as a part of the acquisition by the respondents for the purpose of Surat Lt. Col. Shri Dinkar Nathubhai Desai vs State Of Gujarat on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115457770/
2 Airport.

sentences.text: The details of the various parcels of the land are mentioned which are acquired however, does not include the land of 67540 Sq. Mtrs belonging to the petitioner.

3.7. It is the case of the petitioner that the land admeasuring 5132 Sq.Mtrs and 245140 Sq.Mtrs out of Survey No.230 was acquired and in such large parcel of land, the land admeasuring 64750 Sq.Mtrs belonging to the petitioner was also included though no acquisition proceedings were initiated for the same.
3.8.

It is therefore the case of the petitioner that without there being any acquisition proceeding, land of the petitioner NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/15618/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/04/2023 undefined is in the possession of the respondent No.4.

It was further pointed out by the petitioner that the land acquisition proceedings were initiated and Case No.1 of 1999 and Case No.10 of 1999 (Gaviyar) was lodged under the provisions of land acquisition Act and award was passed for acquiring the land by the Land Acquisition Officer on 22.06.2001 but in the said award also no compensation was awarded to the petitioner for the land of 64750 Sq.Mtrs owned by the petitioner.
3.9.

The petitioner has thereafter sent various communications starting from 16.10.2014 to the respondent No.4 as well as the Executive Engineer, Road and Building, Division I pointing out that during the Airport development process while constructing the boundary wall, the land of the petitioner NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/15618/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/04/2023 undefined is also encroached upon without there being any acquisition.

3.10. The Airport Authority vide letter dated 17.11.2014 addressed to the Deputy Executive Engineer indicated that the land of the petitioner of Survey No.230 was handed over by the Executive Engineer, Road and Building Department and same is part of the Airport Authority.

The petitioner therefore applied for the details under Right to Information Act, 2005 and he was informed by the Deputy Executive Engineer, Road and Building Department that there was no acquisition proceeding with regard to the land of the petitioner.

3.11. The petitioner has therefore preferred this petition with the following prayers :
NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/15618/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/04/2023 undefined "(A) This Hon'ble Court may be pleased admit and allow this petition; (B)
This Hon'ble Court may be pleased issue writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ directing the respondents to remove the illegal encroachment on the land of the petitioner admeasuring 6.47.50 (Hectare paiki 1 of Village Gaviyar, District :
Surat;
OR
This Hon'ble Court may be pleased to direct the respondents to allot other suitable land to the petitioner at any other place;

Lt. Col. Shri Dinkar Nathubhai Desai vs State Of Gujarat on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115457770/
3 (C) Pending admission, hearing and final disposal of this petition, this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to direct the respondents to remove the encroachment on the land of the petitioner forthwith;
(D) To pass such other and further orders necessary in the interest of justice."
4.1.

sentences.text: Learned advocate Mr.K.T.Dave for the petitioner submitted that it is not in disupte that the petitioner was allotted 64750 Sq.Mtrs NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/15618/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/04/2023 undefined of land out which is given a Survey No.230 paiki 1 in the Revenue Record and without there being any acquisition proceeding, the said land is merged into the land acquired for the purpose of Runway by the respondent No.4- Airport Authority of India.
4.2. It was therefore submitted that either the petitioner should be paid compensation or be allotted the suitable parcel of the land admeasuring 64750 Sq.Mtrs at any other place.

5. On the other hand, learned Assistant Government Pleader Ms.Hetal Patel for the respondent Nos.1 to 3 submitted that admittedly there is no acquisition proceeding as per the letter dated 14.08.2015 of the Deputy Executive Engineer addressed to the petitioner and the land of the petitioner is NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/15618/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/04/2023 undefined also not reflected either in the acquisition proceedings and therefore, the respondents may take appropriate steps to regularise the acquisition of the land in question in accordance with law.
6.1. Learned advocate Mr.Bhadrish Raju for the respondent No.4-Airport Authority of India has relied upon the averments made in the affidavit-in-reply filed on behalf of the respondent NO.4 which reads as under :
"4.

I say and submit that the Respondent No.1 viz. State of Gujarat had constructed an Airport at Surat, Gujarat (hereinafter referred to as "Airport") and for the same the Respondent No. 4 had acquired various parcels of land, further, the Respondent No.1 had declared Award dated 22.06.2001 for the acquisition of land in relation to the expansion of runway of the said Airport and accordingly, it is the claim of the petitioner that the land bearing Survey No.230 situated at Gaviyar Village, Surat (hereinafter referred to as "the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/15618/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/04/2023 undefined said land") has not been included in the mentioned award as the same has been wrongfully acquired as government land.

I say and submit that assuming without admitting that the claim made by the petitioner is correct, then also the Respondent No.4 cannot be held liable or responsible as the Respondent No.4 had no link at that point of time with the said land, the airport or with the acquisition.

5. I say and submit that the Respondent No.4 had executed a Memorandum of Understanding (hereinafter referred to as "MOU") dated 30.09.2003 with Respondent No.1 viz. the State of Gujarat wherein the Respondent No.1 had assigned Lt. Col. Shri Dinkar Nathubhai Desai vs State Of Gujarat on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115457770/
4 the ownership of the then "Airport" of Surat to the Respondent No.4.

sentences.text: I say and submit that under Clause 3 of the MOU the Respondent No.1 had agreed to hand over the possession of land admeasuring up to 312.67 hectares which amounted to handing over the possession of the land and assets of the then Surat Airport (hereinafter referred to as "Airport") to the Respondent No.4, further, under Clause 3 (IV), it was categorically agreed that the Respondent No.1 would acquire land as and when the same is required for the expansion of the Airport and shall hand over the same to the Respondent No.4 without any cost and free from all the encumbrances.

Clause 3 of the MOU along with its Sub- clause 4 is reproduced herein:
NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/15618/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/04/2023 undefined "3.

That the assignor shall hand over the possession of existing airport at Surat including land admeasuring an area of 312.67 hectares along with existing assets thereon on "as is where is" basis to the Assignee, free of cost and free from all encumbrances whereupon the ownership of the Surat Airport shall vest in Assignee on the following terms:
I..
II...
III...
IV. The Assignor shall acquire additional land as required for further expansion of airport and transfer the same to Assignee free of cost and free from all encumbrances."

Copy of Memorandum of Understanding executed between Respondent No.1 and Respondent No.4 on 30.09.2003 is annexed hereto and marked as "ANNEXURE-A"."
6.2.

It was submitted that as per the MoU executed between the respondent No.4-Airport Authority of India and the State of Gujarat, NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/15618/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/04/2023 undefined the land and assets are transferred to the respondent No.4 after acquisition proceedings undertaken under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, and therefore, the respondent No.4 is not at all liable to pay any compensation or to allot any land to the petitioner.
6.3. Reliance was placed on Clause 3(I) of the MoU which stipulates that the respondent No.1 shall bear all the expenditure with respect to any present or future claims or liabilities arising out of any present or future litigation pertaining to the land acquisition.
It was therefore submitted that the respondent No.4 is only a formal party and the acquisition of the land in question was of the responsibility and liability of the respondent Nos.1 to 3.

It was also submitted NEUTRAL CITATION Lt. Col. Shri Dinkar Nathubhai Desai vs State Of Gujarat on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115457770/
5 C/SCA/15618/2019 JUDGMENT DATED: 21/04/2023 undefined that the respondent authorities are therefore liable for any compensation to be paid to the petitioner for allotment of the land in question to the respondent No.4 for the Airport purpose.

sentences.text:
7. Having heard the learned advocates for the respective parties, it appears that it is not in dispute that the petitioner was allotted a land admeasuring 64750 Sq.Mtrs out of Survey No.230 paiki 1 and his name is mutated in the Revenue Record on the basis of the allotment order dated 23.12.1970 and the petitioner was put in possession of the land in question as his name is reflected in the Village Form No.7 and 12.
8.

It is also not in dispute that the land of the petitioner is part of the Airport boundary NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/15618/2019 JUDGMENT DATED:
21/04/2023 undefined
as the other parcel of the land of Survey No.230 was acquired for the purpose of Surat Airport.
However, the subject land is not part of any acquisition proceedings.

9. In such circumstances, the respondent Authorities are required to initiate appropriate proceedings under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short 'the Act, 2013') for regularising the acquisition of land admeasuring 64750 Sq.Mtrs situated at Survey No.230 paiki 1 which was allotted to the petitioner in the year 1970 within a period of three months from the date of receipt of the copy of this order.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The respondent authorities are also directed to complete entire procedure of payment of NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/15618/2019 JUDGMENT DATED:
21/04/2023 undefined compensation under the Act, 2013, within a period of three months from the date of receipt of this order.
10. With the aforesaid directions, the petition is disposed of.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.
